INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOMITABLE_DEFAULT.de:
An Illustrious-class aircraft carrier of the Royal Navy.
Among ships that value elegance, tradition, and glory, she seems a bit lacking in motivation.
Though she slacks off most of the time, she's quite reliable when it counts.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOMITABLE_DEFAULT.ba: *Yawn*... How much longer until we can rest?
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOMITABLE_DEFAULT.ev: Sigh... I suppose I have to try a little harder if I want that tea-party...
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOMITABLE_DEFAULT.ar: [sine][blue]If I just stay perfectly still... surely the trouble will pass me by...[/blue][/sine]
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOMITABLE_DEFAULT.go: [sine]I wonder how much premium black tea and pastries I can buy with this...[/sine]
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOMITABLE_DEFAULT.ca: Indomitable's cards will now appear in card rewards and shops.
